title: DSPy Core Primitives
summary: This module defines the foundational building blocks of DSPy programs, including core module structures, signature definitions, essential utilities, and mechanisms for asynchronous execution, streaming, and sandbox serialization. It provides the fundamental abstractions for building robust LLM-powered applications.

nodes.label: Define DSPy Program Logic
nodes.title: DSPy Module
nodes.description: The central class for defining DSPy programs, encapsulating forward logic, sub-modules, and interactions with language models and retrievers.

nodes.label: Manage Module State
nodes.title: Base Module State Management
nodes.description: Provides foundational functionalities for DSPy modules, including parameter management, deep copying, and state serialization/deserialization.

nodes.label: Define Program Signatures
nodes.title: DSPy Signature Definition
nodes.description: A metaclass responsible for dynamically creating DSPy Signature classes, handling field validation, and managing input/output definitions for language model prompts.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Async Execution
nodes.title: Asynchronous Program Execution
nodes.description: Executes DSPy programs asynchronously, managing thread-local overrides and respecting global concurrency limits for non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Enable Program Streaming
nodes.title: DSPy Program Streaming
nodes.description: Wraps standard DSPy programs to enable incremental output streaming, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous consumption and API formatting.

nodes.label: Represent REPL Variables
nodes.title: REPL Variable Metadata
nodes.description: Defines a data structure to hold metadata about a variable in a REPL environment, including its type, description, and a truncated preview for LLMs.

nodes.label: Enable Sandbox Serialization
nodes.title: Sandbox Serializable Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for objects that need to be serialized and reconstructed within a sandboxed Python environment, providing methods for setup and code generation.

nodes.label: Download External Resources
nodes.title: File Download Utility
nodes.description: Provides utility functions for downloading files from URLs, with features like resuming partial downloads and ensuring file integrity.

nodes.label: Execute LM Prediction
nodes.title: DSPy Predictor
nodes.description: A core DSPy component used within Modules to make predictions using a language model based on a defined signature.

nodes.label: Language Model (LM)
nodes.title: DSPy Language Model
nodes.description: The abstract interface for all language models in DSPy, providing text generation capabilities.

nodes.label: Pydantic Base Model
nodes.title: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.description: A foundational class from Pydantic for creating data models, used by SignatureMeta and REPLVariable for robust and validated structures.

nodes.label: Asyncio Event Loop
nodes.title: Python Asyncio Event Loop
nodes.description: The core mechanism for running asynchronous operations in Python, utilized by DSPy for non-blocking execution and streaming.

groups.label: Program Core & Interfaces
groups.title: DSPy Program Core & Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the fundamental structure of DSPy programs, their state management, input/output interfaces, and core language model interaction.

groups.label: Execution & General Utilities
groups.title: Program Execution & Utilities
groups.description: Components for managing program execution flow, including asynchronous operations, and general-purpose utilities like file downloading.

groups.label: Advanced Data Handling
groups.title: Advanced Data Handling Primitives
groups.description: Specialized primitives for handling data streams, representing variables for introspection, and enabling secure serialization for sandboxed environments.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External System Integrations
groups.description: Key external libraries and systems that DSPy's core primitives integrate with, such as language models, data validation frameworks, and asynchronous execution environments.
